notes.title: Death Duel VR META Developer news Blog
notes.content:
[h3]Good Day Duelists, this is Tyrus Rechs, Community Manager for Death Duel VR.

-Playtesters and early user testing access

As of writing this the “Pre-Alpha Death Duel VR” Meta is approximately 80% feature complete.
NOTE: I said 80% feature complete, not bug free. 
We are doing our best to find and fix all bugs before we release the open pre-alpha to the public, but as we are only two developers it is inevitable that a few will get past us. If you wish to help find bugs, join the NA testers on our discord server by submitting an application to the beta-test-application channel in the before mentioned discord! 


-Death Duel VR META Pre-Alpha info

Let me just state that this is not a port of Death Duel VR PC. By the nature of the game (and meta) we have to remake the netcoding. This allows us to do so much more! However with the remake we can up the player count from 2 to 4 Duelists. We hope to EVENTUALLY get 8 players in one lobby split into 4 fighters and 4 spectators. The pre-alpha will launch with a new game mode we call “BOOTCAMP” (see next section about game modes). As well as ALL WEAPONS from pc edition (except legendary) available in pre-alpha.


-The future gamemodes of Death Duel VR META

Over the course of 2025-2026 Death Duel VR META, will eventually receive the following game modes:

*Bootcamp: 4 Player map with access to all weapons and all weapons tiers and armour unlocked. Any kills will NOT increase your player ranking nor will you win any money. The boot camp is for training, think of this mode as custom games. This feature will replace the partyroom mode.
*Death Duel: The standard 1v1 that we all know and love will still be accessible.
*Back 2 Back: a variant of the current game 1v1 Death Duel mode. 2 players will spawn in as a team and fight together against another 2 players.
Warlord: 1 player with full armor and access to all weapons will fight up to 3 players with only limited armor and weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215675/fced3983472856f5b0ab700c15e484586d42d944.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215675/6d530e9933ef65066b543a1e2b4003272b53ebc8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215675/3739fa6c73b830fdb88b42e8544d03a7c730c9d7.jpg[/img]

-Death Duel VR Pre-Alpha side quest launch info*

We have applied for sidequest access with the store page pending approval. Once we have gotten Death Duel VR to a position we are happy with and sidequest approves access, we will launch the pre-alpha! 


-Total transparency from the development team

Death Duel VR PC has been a bumpy road to say the least. For those who don't know, the reason for the amount of bugs is due to our inexperience at game development. This is our team's first ever project. All money goes right back in the game and us at the development team makes zero profit. We are gamers that got tired of people not making the games we want to play. So we made it ourselves. Of course we didn't anticipate how tough this undertaking would be. This has led to numerous bugs and an overall janky experience. Even after 4½ years of development. However there is good news for the new iteration of Death Duel VR.


-IN SUMMARY:

1): We are remaking the game from the ground up.

2): We are adding more gamemodes, to accommodate 4 Duelists at once.

3): Join the NA tester if you are an experienced VR tester to help development.

4): Death Duel VR coming to Sidequest SOONtm 

5): We are only 2 people who are making this game as a hobby. Please be patient, we are not professionals. [/h3]

notes.title: "Duelist's Resolve" Update
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Duelists! We’re thrilled to roll out the "Duelist’s Resolve" update, packed with critical fixes, balancing tweaks, and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:[/h3]

[h3]Multiplayer Stability & Fair Play[/h3]
Duel Integrity: If a player quits/disconnects mid-duel, the duel is immediately revoked. The opponent gracefully exits the ring and respawns as a ghost—no more unfair losses!

Host Migration: When the host disconnects, the server/lobby now seamlessly transfers to another player. Applies to party games only. Say goodbye to dropped sessions!

[h3]Combat & Ability Balancing[/h3]
Lunge Tweak: Post-lunge movement is now slowed by 80% until stamina regenerates past 50%. Use this ability strategically—reckless charges have consequences!

Lock-On Smoothing: Camera tracking now feels buttery-smooth during intense clashes. Never lose sight of your foe!

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Tutorial Ground Collider: Fixed the "falling through the world" bug in tutorial!

PvE Weapon Clashing: Weapon weight simulation now accurately affects both hands during clashes. Heavier weapons = more impactful staggers!

[h3]Map & Scene Optimization[/h3]
Throne Map Separation: The Throne map is now a dedicated scene, decoupled from the Title Menu. Expect faster loads and smoother transitions!

notes.title: New PvP Mechanic - Death Loop
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=aOXZMCDjPvM;full][/previewyoutube]
Major Features Update:

1. Added Swing-Arm-To-Run feature that can be activated while player is not in Fighting Stance and moving forward with thumb stick.  This feature only covers forward direction.  
 
2. Introducing a new core mechanic of PvP - Death Loop.  Death Loop will be activated when there's contact between the players with/without weapons.  Death Loop forces players into low moving speed with thumb stick, but DOF movement is never affected.  Death Loop will stop in 5 seconds if there is no more contact.  Upon activation of Death Loop, the entire world around you is focused on the opponent before you, both you and your opponent suffers 30% reduction on backward speed and 25% reduction on side step speed on top of 50% of general speed reduction, players are forced to stay within attack reach from each other, and have to utilize all their techniques, gears and body movement(DOF) to survive next second. Death Loop will not be triggered while mounted.

notes.title: December Update - Character Overhual
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Duelist’s, This is Community Manager Tyrus Rechs.  I would like to introduce you to our final feature update before launch. This update is to overhaul the sword and player avatar physics. 

We have added an advanced body physics panel in the lobby to add a toggle for advance foot work. As well as advanced upper body muscles. We have received complaints from our testers that these features 'might' cause motion sickness, so they are off by default. However these advanced body physics gives you greater control over your avatar. 

However having these features toggled on will not give you any advantage over your opponent but they will make the avatar respond in a more martial art style, and easier to control.

Next update will be bug fixes and UI fixes to prepare for launch on December 31st. 
[/h3]

Community Manager for Death Duel VR. I'm here to announce our latest update for DDVR which will bring more blood, gore, and dismemberment to the game. This feature will make fighting more realistic. As a playtester put it,
"It feels like I'm wieldling a dangerous weapon now!"

Our developer Doglord has been working hard on other things as well, such as vastly improved tracking and calibration, and a whole host of bug fixes and netcode improvements. 

We also promised a little suprise in the road-map last update. We had to delay it to make certain we could do it. So without further ado, it's time for the suprise announcement you have been waiting for...

Remember always be ... En garde

Sincerely,
Tyrus Rechs 
Change log for dismemberment update:

We have fixed In-game voice communication. 

We have listened and heard your complaints about the calibration. Camera position, arm length and hand tracking is now been greatly improved. 

We have increased damage for hand to hand combat to make Boxing feel more aggressive.

We have fixed the Lock-On system that was added to Fight Stance Mode last update. Lock-on will now work in multiplayer.

We have improved weapon pick-up system to make it absolutely smooth to pick up a weapon in both local and online gameplay.

We have overhauled the netcode and improved it for multiplayer to increase the smoothness of PVP gameplay.

We noticed some complaints about grabbing enemies, thus we have simplified grab mechanics of enemy/players (just pull the trigger to grab).

Main feature:
The dismemberment feature is now here. You can cut off legs, feet, hands, arms, and heads, this is now available for both PVE and PVP gameplay.

[h1]Quick Patch For Singleplayer Update[/h1]

Player will not lose Tier progress in PvE mode, instead player can still farming xp in PvE mode but in a very slow rate.

notes.title: The Way of Duelist Singleplayer Update
notes.content:
[b][h1]-The Way of Duelist Singleplayer Update-[/h1][/b]

Hello Duelist’s, I'm pleased to announce the Death Duel VR Singleplayer overhaul is finally here. 

We will be adding a roguelike game mode. If you die, it'll reset your progress in the singleplayer but keep your xp/money. We have made several quality of life changes to the singleplayer as well as tweaked a few maps. Such as new AI animations. And a whole slew of bug fixes. I hope everyone will enjoy:

[previewyoutube=y1fRyY8Hxzk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: -ROADMAP ANNOUNCEMENT-
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215675/6ff6b58915c7ccaeb561ba6b6e6c563ff320f6a4.png[/img]
[h1]HEAR ‘YE HEAR ‘YE[/h1]

[h3]Hello Duelist’s, I'm pleased to announce the Death Duel VR development roadmap for 2024!

In this article we will be addressing the future of DDVR. At the end of every month we will be releasing a new game update, followed by bug fixes. Each update will be centered around one major feature along with a host of additional improvements. We want to get ongoing feedback and constructive criticism from the community to create the best VR PvP Swordsmanship game we can offer!

This year we hope to pioneer the future of VR physics based PvP sword fighting games ultimately culminating in a full release in Q3-Q4 2025. We have many plans for the future of DDVR that go beyond this year and what you can see in the roadmap. But we can't do it alone! We need a solid community of duelist’s to work sword to sword with the development team in order to accomplish our goals for Death Duel VR.

See you on the dueling grounds![/h3]

[h3]Tyrus Rechs - Community Manager [/h3]

notes.title: VR PvP Grappling Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=VOPh1CF-Znw;full][/previewyoutube]
[olist]
[*] Player can now grapple with opponents in PvP duel, grappling PvP is fully supported with physics
[*] Two duel maps are replaced with new ones
[*] Improved weapon handling to freely and quickly switch Guards
[*] New IK system for better performance and more stable weapon swinging and movment
[*] Further simplified VR Calibration Menu to get more accurate player size with single click
[/olist]

notes.title: VR Multiplayer Physics Total Upgrade
notes.content:
[h3]No More CD Mechanic For VR PvP Online[/h3]

[list]
[*] Real-life Sword Chambering and many other melee weapon techniques now works in online PvP environment.
[*] Players' body is physically interactive in Online PvP environment.
[*] New Auto Match Mode is available for quick online PvP.
[/list]

notes.title: Mounted Combat Update Sep 21
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42199980/f587c964113bc8928df64441c9a3c3fd6eae36ff.jpg[/img]
[b]Mounted Combat Update Sep 16, 2022:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Add four horses with three types of horse armors for player to choose from. Make sure click on "Save Horse" to spawn it in Horse Supported Match.
[*] Add 2 new maps for Tier 3 and 2 new maps for Tier4. Three of them are supporting Horse feature with Horse Logo on Map Selection.
[*] Add polearm weapons for Tier 5.
[/olist]
[b]Note: For the purpose of testing, Players receive Tier 5 Rank for this update on playtest version, so they can jump into try mounted combat/jousting with no delay.  Demo version add one polearm weapon, one basic horse(no armor), and a new map with horse combat feature.[/b]

notes.title: Advanced Clashing & Impact Update July 16
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42199980/eed6dd6dcc389c367dbf1dc5952f35331aec84b1.jpg[/img]
[b]Advanced Clashing & Impact Update July 16, 2022:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Further improved clashing physics for multiplayer.
[*] The force impact upon weapon clashing will affect character’s arms to have a short stunt just like hitting something in real life.
[*] Improved syncing of damage system for guest players, so they will not receive damage when the weapon is still a foot away from their character.
[*] Some tweaks for Two-Handed weapons.
[*] Some tweaks for Arms movement for better responsiveness.
[*] Hook Dagger added for Tier 1 weapon and Hook Sword added for Tier2 Weapon.
[/olist]
[previewyoutube=V7A296ggoKk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update June 25
notes.content:
[b]Performance Update[/b]
[olist]
[*] Further improved stableness and smoothness of player movement.
[*] Reset VR camera to more accurate position so that player can have accurate sense of distance and arm length.
[*] Improved Calibration system to better reflect size of player.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs
[/olist]

[b]Demo Update[/b]
Three weapons are provided immediately on weapon table, so that new player can get into action at no delay. Armoury is now locked, to have more experience and access to more weapons, please opt into playtest on Steam.
